title: Workspace Directory query native function inventory
$comment: Static PostgreSQL function inventory for the Workspace-owned Directory query boundary. Canonical wire DTO definitions are maintained by the Workspace contract owner.

functions.semantics: Validate the closed Directory request and action bindings, delegate Project get_row/actor_status/member_access phases to the fixed Project query RPC, and return {schema,request,action,parameters,facts}. Directory reads are stable, read-only and scoped to the declared action parameters.

identity_functions.semantics: Return active super-admin accounts ordered by name only; Identity owns this function and grants execution to WorkspaceCode.

internal_functions.semantics: Reject non-object, missing, duplicate-count, and unknown protocol keys.
